answer: An autonomous AI economic network can achieve robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to stake cryptographic capital against their performance, anchoring reputation like a sturdy jetty securing ships. Because every false signal emitted by these unverified entities incurs immediate slashing penalties, the marginal cost of scaling a Sybil attack quickly exceeds any potential financial yield.
